_doc: Named parameter sets for sim_watchdog.py; `sim_watchdog.py params --profile NAME` lists the effect of each. Override single values with --set key=value.

ffn_prefill._doc: FFN prefill on the 16c4m platform (workloads/ffn): host init takes a few ms of simulated time, the window a few ms, and no task runs longer than a few tens of us.

moe_prefill._doc: MoE prefill on the 16c4m platform (workloads/moe, array shape 3): host init a few ms of simulated time, the window a few ms at full size; the route's top-6 is one long task on the root.

fa_prefill._doc: FA prefill on the 16c4m platform (workloads/fa, array shape 0): host init takes several ms of simulated time (a task list of a few thousand tasks a cluster), the window 0.6 ms at 1,024 keys and a few ms at the real size; the GEMM waits and the chain gathers are the long tasks.

dsv2_prefill._doc: DeepSeek-V2-Lite whole-layer prefill on the 16c4m platform (workloads/dsv2/layer{0,1}/prefill): the input norm, the attention (array shape 0) and the glue on the root, then the MoE (array shape 3); host init several ms of simulated time, the window a few ms; the args-phase loads and the glue's tiles are short, the GEMM waits and the chain gathers the long tasks.

llama3_prefill._doc: Llama-3-8B prefill on the 16c4m platform (workloads/llama3, synthetic weights): the FFN and the attention as tensor-parallel blocks over every cluster, passes of 64 rows with the weights streamed each pass; host init about a ms of simulated time; the chain gathers and the GEMM waits are the long tasks.

cerf_node._doc: Decode one-node control-path benchmark on the 16c4m platform (workloads/cerf_node): empty kernels, rounds of a few us each, the host arm a host task per chiplet that relaunches one node between chip barriers; the whole run well under a ms of simulated time after host init. The host arm's printout runs with no task moving, hence the longer quiet limit.

decode._doc: one decode token over a 1,024-token KV cache on the 16c4m platform (workloads/llama3/decode, workloads/dsv2/layer{0,1}/decode): host init a few hundred us of simulated time, the window under 1 ms; weight-stream bound, so ring loads and their waits are the long tasks.
